lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately five to six horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The central rows exhibit a more regular, equidistant spatial arrangement compared to the more scattered dorsal and ventral clusters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a grid-like pattern where spots act as anchor nodes, particularly prominent in the mid-lateral region posterior to the fourth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single, prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge and a distinct shadow on the ventral edge, extending from the supra-branchial region posteriorly.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density distribution of smaller, heterogeneously sized high-luminance spots that are notably more compact than the primary flank constellation.
